# City of Malden
## Massachusetts
### Board of Appeal
215 Pleasant Street
Malden, Massachusetts 02148

Telephone 781-397-7000 x 2104

## Board of Appeal - Public Meeting
## September 16, 2026
## Minutes

The Malden Board of Appeal held a Public Hearing Wednesday September 16, 2026, at 6:30 pm at Malden City Hall, 215 Pleasant St., Room #106 Herbert L Jackson Council Chambers, Malden, MA on the following named petitions:

Roll Call: D'Esposito, Bilgen, King, Yu and Froio
Absent: Cramer and Sherwin
In Nate Cramer's absence, Steve Froio sat in as acting Chairperson
In Adam Sherwin and Nate Cramer's absence, Alex Yu and Maria D'Esposito were asked to sit in as voting members.

Minutes: Motion by D'Esposito to approve the minutes from the August 19, 2026, meeting, 2nd by King – All in favor.

**Petition 26-007** by **Mystic Valley Regional Charter School** seeking a variance under Code of the City of Malden as amended – **Title 4 Section 4.16.090 (A) Table of Intensity Regulations: Specifically: Awning sign in the Residence A Zoning District as per plans SGER-077161-2026** at the property known as and numbered **31 Granite St., Malden, MA and also known by City Assessor's**

Petition 26-007 is being represented by Alfred Carrier, President of Carrier Associates, the company that is designing the sign.

King and Bilgen both asked if the only reason this is in front of the Board is because of the Residential A zoning, which Mr. Carrier replied yes.

No one appeared in support or in opposition.

Motion by D'Esposito to approve Petition 26-007, 2nd by King: D'Esposito – Yes, Bilgen – Yes, King – Yes, Yu – Yes, Froio – Yes. Petition has been approved by a vote of 5-0.

Motion to adjourn made by Yu, 2nd by Bilgen – All in favor. Adjourned at 6:38pm.
headline: Approved variance for awning sign at 31 Granite St. sought by Mystic Valley Regional Charter School, 5-0.
summary: The board reviewed Petition 26-007 from Mystic Valley Regional Charter School, seeking a variance for an awning sign in the Residence A Zoning District at 31 Granite St., Malden, MA. No one spoke in support or opposition, and the board approved the petition by a vote of 5-0.
decisions: Approved the minutes from the August 19, 2026, meeting.
Approved Petition 26-007 by Mystic Valley Regional Charter School for a variance for an awning sign in the Residence A Zoning District at 31 Granite St., Malden, MA, by a vote of 5-0.
